items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Raybone had one of the famous brass bands.

ctx.x: What about the funerals out there? Are they similar to the funerals here with brass bands?

Well, yes. Raybone had one of the famous brass bands. They'd had, like we had in New Orleans, I mean like when they'd have a funeral, the brass band would play. Now they didn't have so much second line like we had. They had some of it and then they would play a kind of jazz tune coming back, you see. But I wouldn't say it was glamorous as New Orleans was, you know. They didn't do it that way so much. And then I remember when I was a kid and I think it was the Baptist and Methodist they used to have where they'd…
Just to check the dates on the thing now, when were you born?
